polities.name: Zagros hill tribes
polities.cohesionNote: 2200, equal to ligurians, caspian-peoples, dahae-parni, marsh-peoples and hejaz-tribes: clans in defensible country who answered to no common seat, but who could and did close a pass to a marching army. Above makran-tribes (2000), which is desert and has no such record of joint action. Kept below the 2500 ceiling because the four peoples never acted together.
polities.notes: The hill peoples of the Zagros and the Taurus edge, put together from four groups the record names separately and treats alike. Carduchi (Kardouchoi): the mountains north and east of the Tigris plain, from Hakkari to the Sharazur hills; Xenophon crossed them in 401 and found them unsubdued by the Great King (Anabasis 3.5 and 4.1-3). Cossaeans (Kossaioi): the Luristan hills between Susiana and Media; Alexander campaigned against them in the winter of 324/3 and Diodorus 19.19 says they had never obeyed a king and took toll from the Persian kings on their road to Media; Antigonus paid it or fought for it in 317. Uxians (Ouxioi): the upper Uxii of the hills between Susiana and Persis, who also took toll of the Persian kings (Arrian 3.17; Strabo 15.3.6). Mardi: the Bakhtiari and Alvand country (the Caspian Mardi are in caspian-peoples). Evidence for 270 itself is absent for all four; the Seleucids held the roads (Kambadene and Bisitun, Laodicea in Media, Susa, Elymais) and no Seleucid governor is attested in these hills, so they are drawn as one placeholder tribal actor of the class of pisidia-isauria, makran-tribes and hejaz-tribes. No seat, no ruler and no settlement is attested, so none is given; the wells, passes and camps of these peoples are not on the record. The rings cover only upland; the lowlands, valley floors and coastal plain of the same regions (the Assyrian plain with Arbela and Kirkuk, the Little Zab valley, the Nippur plain, the Karkheh and Dez plains, Bushehr coast) stay Seleucid, as do Kambadene, Elymais and Media. Fold back into seleucid-empire if the lead wants no tribal actor here.

notes: Four rings, one polity: the Carduchian and Vaspurakan hills (Hakkari to the Sharazur), the Cossaean hills of Luristan, the Uxian hills of Kohgiluyeh and the Bakhtiari (Mardia) hills. They are not contiguous: Kambadene, Elymais and Media, which stay Seleucid, lie between them.

ORDER. These rings are meant to be tested BEFORE the Seleucid default of their theatre file (the default is last in each file, so 'first match wins' takes the Zagros rings first, and only provinces that would otherwise fall to seleucid-empire matter: the rings are drawn clear of every ring of armenia, atropatene and the other files, which check-zagros-polities.cjs verifies). The builder does not read this file yet: it needs 'zagros' added to THEATRES in build-map-graph.ts so the polity is known, and the same rings are given as the first four assignments in ownership-corrections-seleucid.json, which the builder does read, pins against the smoothing pass, and applies after the overlay. With both, the polity is created by this file and populated by the corrections.

EXCLAVES. The smoothing pass folds small pieces of a polity on one landmass into the polity around them unless a capital or anchor keeps them; this polity has none. Provinces named in an ownership-corrections file are pinned, so the four pieces should survive, and the builder will list them under 'polities still in several pieces on one landmass'.

PROTECTED PLACES. No ring holds a Seleucid capital, city or anchor: Susa, Ecbatana, Laodicea in Media, Bisitun (Kambadene), Arbela, Kirkuk, Nineveh, Nippur, Babylon, Seleucia, Gabae and Persepolis are all outside and are checked by name in check-zagros-polities.cjs.
STRAYS. Three Matiane upland provinces of the Sharazur (irn-gyx5z, irn-m1qt5, irn-p9l2i) fall in the first ring; they are hill country next to the Carduchian hills and are taken with them.

SIZE. On the map as built on 2026-09-30 the rings take 55 provinces, all held by seleucid-empire: 17 Cossaea, 14 Uxia, 11 Carduchia, 7 Mardia, 3 Vaspurakan and the 3 Matiane uplands. The other provinces of those five regions are named lowland, coastal or valley (Carduchia 25 left, Cossaea 17, Uxia 16, Vaspurakan 5, Mardia 1) and stay Seleucid, apart from the Urmia strip, which is Carduchia by name and is left to the atropatene assignment in ownership-corrections-seleucid.json.

ARMENIA. Five Vaspurakan-labelled and three northern Carduchia provinces (lat 37.2 to 37.7, lon 42.3 to 44.6) lie inside the Armenian ring but are Seleucid on the current build. The Zagros rings stop at the Armenian ring's south edge and do not take them. They are an inconsistency of the build (ring says Armenia), not a Zagros question; the lead may want them assigned to armenia.
COHESION. 2200. Sources: Xenophon Anabasis 3.5 and 4.1-3, Arrian 3.17, Diodorus 17.111 and 19.19, Strabo 15.3.1-6 (recalled, not re-read).
